_comment: Your standing weekly availability. 'all-day' or 'off'. The web UI does not read this file, only the CLI does.
_weeklyHourCap: Warn when a week goes over this many hours. null disables it. On-campus student jobs are often capped at 20 during term.
_pay: Remove this block to hide the pay panel. nightFrom/nightTo are start hours, so 0-6 means a shift starting at midnight bills at the night rate. taxRate is your own effective withholding, taken off a real payslip, not a guess.
_maps: Station names are turned into Google Maps searches. campus is appended to sharpen the search. Put an override in stations only when Google resolves a name badly, e.g. "INV Northwest 1": "42.3406,-71.0890".
